book_call.label: Book a founder call
book_call.description: The lead asks for a conversation or is clearly ready to buy: offer concrete call slots right away
book_call.text: Hi {first_name}, thanks for reaching out. What you describe is exactly what we build. Would Tuesday 11:00 or Thursday 15:00 (CET) work for a 30-minute call? I'll bring two examples from {industry_label} teams of your size.

send_case_study_agency.label: Send the agency case study
send_case_study_agency.description: A marketing agency, studio or agency-like service business that fits but has not asked for a call yet: lead with a similar agency's result
send_case_study_agency.text: Hi {first_name}, one of our agency clients cut monthly reporting from three days to twenty minutes per client. Here is the two-page write-up. If it resonates, happy to walk you through how it would look for {company_name}.

send_case_study_coach.label: Send the coaching case study
send_case_study_coach.description: A coach or course business that fits but has not asked for a call yet: lead with a coaching business's result
send_case_study_coach.text: Hi {first_name}, a coaching business with a similar setup automated their applicant follow-up and onboarding; enrolments went up without more sales calls. Here is the short case study. Happy to show how it would map to {company_name}.

ask_qualifying_question_size.label: Ask about team size and clients
ask_qualifying_question_size.description: The pain fits but company size, revenue or client count is unknown: ask one qualifying question before investing time
ask_qualifying_question_size.text: Hi {first_name}, thanks for the note. Quick question so I can point you to the right examples: roughly how many clients do you serve today, and how big is the team?

ask_qualifying_question_pain.label: Ask what to automate first
ask_qualifying_question_pain.description: The company fits but the message does not say what hurts: ask which process they would automate first
ask_qualifying_question_pain.text: Hi {first_name}, appreciate you reaching out. If you could hand one recurring task at {company_name} to software tomorrow, which one would it be? That tells me where to start.

add_to_nurture.label: Add to nurture
add_to_nurture.description: The lead is browsing or the fit is weak: no personal outreach, add to the newsletter and content track
add_to_nurture.text: Added to the {industry_label} nurture track. No personal outreach; re-scored automatically when they reply or visit again.

route_to_account_owner.label: Hand to the account owner
route_to_account_owner.description: The company is already a customer or an open opportunity in the CRM
route_to_account_owner.text: Existing account: {account_name} (owner {account_owner}). Message forwarded to the owner; no new outreach sequence started.

decline_politely.label: Polite decline (draft)
decline_politely.description: Vendor pitches, students, competitors, enterprises and pre-revenue companies: draft a polite decline for a human to glance at
decline_politely.text: Hi {first_name}, thanks for getting in touch. We are not the right fit for this at the moment, but I appreciate you thinking of us. All the best with it.
